latest_release.name: v0.9.1
latest_release.body:
# GPUI Kit v0.9.1

GPUI Kit 0.9.1 is a backward-compatible patch release. It adds a draggable GridLayout, right-pinned table columns, Markdown task checkboxes, link tooltips and motion transitions that outlive their element, along with a large batch of input, text, slider, accessibility and gpui-shell hardening fixes. The default backend moves to gpui-pre 0.3.12 and the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.14.

## New APIs

- **GridLayout**: a grid whose items the user drags and resizes, also registered in the gpui-shell component catalog. ([#3770](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3770), [#3789](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3789))
- **Table**: `ColumnFixed::Right` pins columns to the right edge. ([#3833](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3833))
- **Text**: `on_task_toggle` makes Markdown task checkboxes clickable; block surfaces in `TextView`; pointer-following link tooltips. ([#3811](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3811), [#3830](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3830), [#3793](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3793))
- **Motion**: `TransitionState` for transitions that outlive their element. ([#3841](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3841))
- **Components**: `Button::selected_accent`, `Slider::track_focus`, `Dialog::accessibility_label`, `TimeField::separator`, `Toolbar::axis` for vertical toolbars, and a ratio-sized PieChart hole. ([#3775](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3775), [#3824](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3824), [#3826](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3826), [#3829](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3829), [#3821](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3821), [#3784](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3784))
- **WindowBorder**: the frame colour comes from the `window.border` theme token, and window corners can be rounded on request. ([#3849](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3849), [#3848](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3848))

## Editor and text input

- Keep the first typed character in the editor search panel, compose decoration styles deterministically, draw a placeholder for a folded line, and show the arrow over the gutter. ([#3772](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3772), [#3777](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3777), [#3791](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3791), [#3806](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3806))
- Tell the platform when the caret moves, publish layout at the end of prepaint, notify a moved input only while focused, and wait for the first layout before shaping an early value. ([#3827](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3827), [#3831](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3831), [#3828](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3828), [#3864](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3864))
- Keep the caret's visual line at soft wraps. ([#3842](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3842))

## Markdown and text rendering

- Supply editor foreground ranges through the render context and give span-less HTML paragraphs unique ids. ([#3754](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3754), [#3771](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3771))
- Tables: highlight the hovered body row, select aligned cell text where it is drawn, and size columns to their images. ([#3812](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3812), [#3813](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3813), [#3787](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3787))
- Limit selection highlights to selected glyphs, draw unsized inline images at their own size, and avoid quadratic paragraph highlight merging. ([#3799](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3799), [#3786](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3786), [#3846](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3846))

## Components

- **Table / DataTable**: name rows after their cells, centre default header names, Tab and Shift+Tab l
